'''October 2004 Franklin tournament''' was a ''Star Wars'' CCG local tournament held on Saturday 23 October 2004 at 2:00 pm at Outer Limits in Franklin, Tennessee; [[Micah Wooten]] announced it and reported the turnout.<ref name="pcf-2860-54919">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=54919#54919 Tennessee tournaments], Micah Wooten (KeonUlic), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (6 October 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050224204034/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=58049%26amp Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="pcf-2860-55364">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=55364#55364 Tennessee tournaments], Micah Wooten (KeonUlic), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (25 October 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050224204034/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=58049%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> The Franklin monthly tournament was usually held on the third Saturday of the month, but in October 2004 it was moved to 23 October because of the [[WARS TCG]] release weekend. Wooten posted event information on a DeckTech group page.<ref name="pcf-2860-54919" />

Eleven players took part. Wooten announced the next event for 20 November 2004 at 12:00 pm at Outer Limits and asked whether players wanted a sealed-deck event.<ref name="pcf-2860-55364" />

== Format ==

* '''Site:''' Outer Limits, Franklin, Tennessee<ref name="pcf-2860-55364" />
* '''Dates:''' 23 October 2004<ref name="pcf-2860-54919" /><ref name="pcf-2860-55364" />
* '''Contact:''' [[Micah Wooten]]<ref name="pcf-2860-54919" />
* '''Players:''' 11<ref name="pcf-2860-55364" />

== Results ==
